name: Demo G2: Add-Like Redline Tag
description: Exercise an add-like redline operation using a disposable tag target: create a bounded tag, prove it is visible, write a deterministic visual gate, and clean it up.
setup_instructions: Open a disposable Revit model or a model that can be closed without saving.
Use a view that supports tagging the configured element id.
Use a taggable target element in the same view so repeated live runs create and delete only disposable tag elements.
success_criteria: A disposable tag id is created in the requested view for the requested target element.
The created tag id is visible in the post-add visible-element inventory.
A deterministic add visual gate artifact passes using post-change capture evidence.
The created tag is cleaned up with native dry-run and applied delete effect evidence.
failure_criteria: The tag target is not created or is created in the wrong view.
The post-add visible-element inventory does not contain the created tag id.
The add visual gate artifact is missing or fails.
The cleanup delete dry-run/apply omits the tag id from effect evidence.
grader_notes: This task closes the first tag add/move/delete benchmark trio by adding an explicit add-like tag workflow.
Do not count requestedIds-only cleanup responses as evidence; cleanup must return ids, deletedIds, or impactedIds.
